Page: Ministro Pistarini International Airport. - Ministro Pistarini International Airport is 22 km south-southwest of the Autonomous City of Buenos Aires, Argentina's capital.
- Ministro Pistarini International Airport has the IATA code EZE and the ICAO code SAEZ.
- Ministro Pistarini International Airport is Argentina's largest international airport by passengers handled and accounts for 85% of the country's international air traffic.
- Ministro Pistarini International Airport is a hub for international flights of Aerolíneas Argentinas and LATAM Argentina.
